description: Calculate RPM at cruise speed and top speed at redline in every gear from tire size, axle ratio, transfer case and transmission ratios. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/gear-ratio-calc

gears.description: Transmission gear ratios — Comma-separated, 1 to 12 gears, for example 3.36, 2.10, 1.49, 1.19, 1.00, 0.79.

redline.description: Redline (RPM) — Used for top speed in each gear.

speed.description: Cruise speed (mph) — Used for the RPM at cruise.

tire.description: Tire diameter (in) or tire size — A diameter such as 27.0, or a metric size such as 245/45R18.

transfer.description: Transfer case ratio — 1.0 for none; 2.72 is a typical low range.

name: calculate_gear_ratio
title: Gear Ratio, RPM & Speed Calculator
